examples.comment: Correction: no more than 35% of finished runtime may come from still images in any form. Static slides, Ken Burns, depth animation, cinemagraph treatment, and staged keyframe animation all count toward the same still-derived 35%. At least 65% must be genuine recorded or generated temporal footage with people, objects, or environments actually moving; the permitted stills should still receive the motion treatment.
Lets replace the Text Boxes with still images with any special effects.

STANDING RULE (fallback visuals): when genuine stock footage cannot be found for a scene, the pipeline auto-generates an APPEALING SPECIAL-EFFECTS STILL IMAGE that represents the line (via hero.py effects style) — never a plain text/label graphic box. Implemented in storyline_footage._render_storyboard.

STORYLINE STANDARD (set by the approved 'The Room Behind You'): the viewer must be able to SEE the storyline scene by scene. Every visual literally depicts its spoken line's object/mechanism (game render-distance -> game footage; blind spot -> eye with void pupil; brain faking it -> painted-over wall). Concrete beats use genuine moving stock; abstract beats use effects stills. Keep this bar on every video.

EFFECTS STILLS: James wants generated stills to carry HEAVY, layered special effects (god rays, dense particles, energy trails, mist, bokeh, flares, iridescent glow) - maximally cinematic, never plain. Style lives in storyline_footage.EFFECTS_STILL_STYLE.

candidates.title: Prefer genuine moving stock when a direct match exists

examples.comment: Hand/cane fusion looks synthetic and risks malformed fingers. Replace with real stock footage of a gloved hand using a cane or tool, emphasizing repeated controlled motion; no morphing, dissolving, or exposed fingers.

Default still and hero slides must look like natural photographic frames that match the surrounding stock footage. Avoid gold fog, heavy volumetric haze, silhouetted figures, theatrical fantasy lighting, and visibly synthetic staging unless explicitly requested.

Still-image training from 2026-07-14: acquire genuine stock slides first, then choose the closest related selected stock-video frame and use that exact frame as the generated still's visual reference. Every still receives the full natural-photo, exposure/detail, depth/background, internal-motion, practical-light, grade, and grain treatment; preserve supplied originals, reject pan/zoom-only slides, keep all still-derived time inside the 35% cap, and fall back to genuine footage rather than emit an unreferenced generated still.

Other Versions of You was fully rejected. Start ordinary videos from genuine literal stock footage for every scene. Avoid multiple unrelated faces; prefer consistent hands, rear views, objects, places, and physical actions. Do not use deterministic symbolic graphics, generic low-grade graphics, hero images, or stills unless exact stock searching has genuinely failed and James explicitly accepts a substantially higher-grade fallback. Narrative correspondence and premium photographic realism outrank abstract visual cleverness.

STANDING RULE (fallback visuals): when genuine stock footage cannot be found for a scene, the pipeline auto-generates an APPEALING SPECIAL-EFFECTS STILL IMAGE that represents the line (via hero.py effects style) — never a plain text/label graphic box. Implemented in storyline_footage._render_storyboard.
